name: Portale Funebre Necrologi
author: digitaliasrl

sections.description:
Display and manage Memora obituaries directly from your WordPress website.

External services

This plugin connects to Memora to retrieve and display obituary data, ceremony information, images, statistics, and condolence settings configured for the connected account. It sends the configured client ID and API key when the site requests obituary lists, single obituary data, or statistics.

When a visitor submits a condolence message, the plugin sends the submitted form data to Memora, including the obituary slug, selected delivery type, first name, last name, email address, phone number, and message text, plus the answers to any additional fields the site administrator adds to the condolence form. The plugin also creates optional WhatsApp share/contact links using WhatsApp URLs when WhatsApp condolences or sharing are enabled for an obituary.

Memora is provided by Digitalia Srl. Service information and terms: https://portalefunebre.com/ . Privacy Policy: https://digitalia.srl/dichiarazione-sulla-privacy-ue/ .

WhatsApp is provided by WhatsApp LLC/Meta. Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service . Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy .

When the IndexNow option is enabled (default) and the site allows search engines to index it, the plugin notifies IndexNow when an obituary is published, updated or removed. It sends the site host, the site’s IndexNow key and the list of the affected obituary URLs to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow , which shares them with the participating search engines (such as Microsoft Bing). No visitor data is sent. IndexNow terms: https://www.indexnow.org/terms . Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement . The option can be disabled in the plugin settings (SEO tab).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directly, or install it from the WordPress plugin’s page.
  2. Activate the plugin within the ‘Plugin’ page in WordPress.
  3. Use the plugin by the menu in the WordPress backend admin.
sections.faq:
How Does Portale Funebre Necrologi Work?

It offers an API Interface for linking Memora directly to your website.

Where can i get in touch to receive support?

To receive support, contact us at support@portalefunebre.com.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • First plugin version.
  • PortaleFunebre API integration
  • Stats displaying
  • Single and List Obits display
  • Add various display settings

1.0.1

  • Fixed facebook sharing

1.0.2

  • Improved vertical layout image on facebook share
  • Added option to open in a new tab for the main image on the single obituary

1.0.5

  • Added support for obituaries sorting on obituaries list
  • SEO compliant H1 for single obituary title
  • GoogleMap now forced to use italian as language
  • Using italian format for date in the Obituaries page

1.1.0

  • SEO: obituaries, lists and slider are rendered server side, so search engines read names, texts and links directly in the HTML
  • SEO: each obituary has its own title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags and structured data (Person and funeral Event)
  • SEO: Yoast SEO integration (meta, breadcrumbs, schema graph and an obituaries sitemap in the Yoast sitemap index); WordPress core sitemaps are used when Yoast is not active
  • SEO: real 404 status for missing obituaries and temporary 503 status when the portal cannot be reached
  • SEO: periodic update check that refreshes page caches and notifies IndexNow when obituaries change
  • Sharing: share buttons now share the obituary URL directly, which has its own Open Graph tags with the compact photo preview; old /pf-share/ links permanently redirect to the obituary
  • New SEO settings tab with search result preview
  • Obituaries admin page rebuilt as a standard WordPress list table (search, views, sorting, pagination)
  • New obituary detail page in the admin: all portal data, received condolences, and per-obituary SEO settings (SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase with analysis, noindex, canonical URL, social title, description and image)
  • Local cache of portal data, with a backup copy used when the portal does not respond
  • Advanced condolence form editor
